# Valve cover gasket replacement

## Summary

[Partial] [Unverified value] Replace valve covers with new gaskets using a high-quality torque wrench set to 74 in-lb. [t313]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the valve covers from both sides of the engine.
2. [Partial] Install new gaskets onto the cylinder head or cover as required.

_Procedure reported by [t313]._

## Specifications

- **Valve cover bolt torque**: 74 in-lb [t313] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a high-quality torque wrench capable of reading low values accurately to avoid breaking fasteners. [t313]
- Apply RTV sealant around the pintles at the front of the heads where covers meet the phasing solenoids. [t313]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] [Unverified value] Overtorquing bolts (e.g., 20 ft-lb) which can snap them or squish seals. [t313]
- [Partial] Ignoring low-torque specifications entirely, leading to insufficient clamp load and leaks. [t313]
